department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

requirements.name: Programming
requirements.note: ECE 15 required all depths; + ECE 17 or 18 for comm/systems/ML/signal depths
requirements.note_zh: ECE 15 所有方向必修；通信/系统/机器学习/信号方向另加 ECE 17 或 18

requirements.name: Physics
requirements.note_zh: PHYS 2A-B-C 或 4A-B-C（部分方向：2A-B-C-D 或 4A-B-C-D-E）

requirements.name: Design course (choose one, C- or better)
requirements.note: Required for graduation; written design project must be submitted
requirements.name_zh: 设计课（选一门，成绩 ≥ C-）
requirements.note_zh: 毕业必须；须提交书面设计项目

requirements.name: Professional electives (two upper-division courses)
requirements.note: Open pool: any two upper-division courses
requirements.name_zh: 职业选修（两门高年级课）
requirements.note_zh: 开放池：任意两门高年级课

requirements.name: Depth: Communication Systems (choose one depth for the major)
requirements.note: All breadth + all 6 depth courses required
requirements.name_zh: 深度方向：通信系统（须选一个方向）
requirements.note_zh: 广度课全修 + 6 门深度课全修

requirements.name: Depth: Computer System Design (choose one depth for the major)
requirements.note: Breadth all required; any 5 of the depth list (ECE 111 must be taken as depth, tech elective, or design)
requirements.name_zh: 深度方向：计算机系统设计（须选一个方向）
requirements.note_zh: 广度课全修；深度清单任选 5 门（ECE 111 必须作为深度课、技术选修或设计课修读）

requirements.name: Depth: Electronic Circuits and Systems (choose one depth for the major)
requirements.note: All breadth + all 3 depth courses required
requirements.name_zh: 深度方向：电子电路与系统（须选一个方向）
requirements.note_zh: 广度课全修 + 3 门深度课全修

requirements.name: Depth: Electronic Devices and Materials (choose one depth for the major)
requirements.note: All breadth + all 4 depth courses required
requirements.name_zh: 深度方向：电子器件与材料（须选一个方向）
requirements.note_zh: 广度课全修 + 4 门深度课全修

requirements.name: Depth: Machine Learning and Controls (choose one depth for the major)
requirements.note: Breadth all required; depth: 171A+174+175A and one of 171B/172A/175B
requirements.name_zh: 深度方向：机器学习与控制（须选一个方向）

requirements.name: Depth: Photonics (choose one depth for the major)
requirements.note: Breadth all required; depth: 181+182+183 and either 184 or 185
requirements.name_zh: 深度方向：光子学（须选一个方向）

requirements.name: Depth: Power Engineering (choose one depth for the major)
requirements.note: Breadth all required; depth: 121A-B+125A+128A and either 125B or 128B
requirements.name_zh: 深度方向：电力工程（须选一个方向）
requirements.note_zh: 广度课全修；深度：121A-B+125A+128A，再加 125B 或 128B

requirements.name: Depth: Signal and Image Processing (choose one depth for the major)
requirements.note: All breadth + all 4 depth courses required
requirements.name_zh: 深度方向：信号与图像处理（须选一个方向）
requirements.note_zh: 广度课全修 + 4 门深度课全修
